subject: [hw] IP -> R2: F14-F21 addressed; F15 fixed with extracted objects + whole-archive + table assertions
body:
Your F14 snapshot was from 15:55; the fatal path landed at 16:13 and is now tested. Current:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 758/758
    248/248 ASan+UBSan, 248/248 -O2, 248/248 TSan, 14/14 real n2vhost.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK; vcodecd 373920, n2vcd_cli 70000, linked.

F14 (exit 70): fatal_guest_stop() now has call sites in OPEN (initial and AP-open/start failures), force-key, encode, ENC_SET and watchdog. It replies E_GUEST to the owner with the request seq, sends seq-0 E_GUEST to every other client that has sent traffic, logs one fatal line (reason text includes the address), drops VENC/VENC_C1 refs raw (does not take V41 registry mutexes), `_exit(70)`. Fake test: request-time stop -> owner E_GUEST, second client seq-0 E_GUEST, process exit status 70; watchdog stop -> same. install/com.nord2.vcodecd.plist: RunAtLoad true, --gate marker, KeepAlive {SuccessfulExit:false}, ThrottleInterval 10. The earlier "unused note_client" is gone.

F15: build_ios.sh now extracts IV archive members and links them directly, excluding n2vc_hw_fake.o. `llvm-nm vcodecd` shows `_n2shim_thread` and `_n2shim_stdio` present and zero `n2vc_hw_open_fake`; product 373920 bytes. The IP-REAL link uses `-Wl,--whole-archive libn2vhost.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive`, and t_real asserts the `N2VHOST tables ... thread=N stdio=N` line is non-zero and unresolved= is logged. 14/14.

F16: session_end/fatal drop power through g.vhw when present.
F17: --session-idle-ms default 10000 (0 disables); test daemon 1000, opens, sleeps 1.5s, gets seq-0 E_SESSION, OPEN works again. Keeps serving (not a guest stop).
F18: 16-entry registry now LRU-evicts the oldest (V41 supports 256); it no longer permanently rejects handle 17.
F19: enc_cap/out_limit use the registered bytes when RWVC_DMA_INFO knows them, and input smaller than OPEN_OK.in_buf_bytes is E_ARGS.
F20: in_handle == out_handle is E_ARGS; ENC_SET/open bounds were already fixed (bitrate/fps/gop, flags, unknown profile/level).
F21: build_ios compiles with -Werror now.

Protocol/session code unchanged otherwise. Please re-run and post the verdict.
